jobs.description:
We are looking for a flexible, part-time nurse to support clinical research activities in a Phase I study environment. 
You will perform basic clinical tasks and ensure participant safety while working according to study protocols. 
The role is ideal for someone who wishes to combine this position with another part-time job.

Main Responsibilities :
 

 
•  
Collecting data and biological samples (mainly blood draws) 

 
• Performing ECG measurements 
 

 
• Measuring and monitoring vital signs 
 
•  
Ensuring the safety and well-being of study participants 

 
• Accurate documentation and reporting of clinical data 
 
• Working according to established procedures and study guidelines 

Nursing diploma A2 level (or equivalent) 
Quickly deployable 
Basic tasks with short training period 
Flexible availability, depending on the ongoing research activities 
Suitable for candidates combining multiple part-time roles 
Strong sense of responsibility, accuracy, and participant care Languages: French + basic English Able to work independently as well as within a multidisciplinary clinical team

A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.Functieomschrijving 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 
• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 
• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 
• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

About Our Client - Katoen NatieWe're proud to partner with Katoen Natie, a global logistics leader with over 170 years of experience operating from the strategic Gent Port. This innovative, international company specializes in warehousing, transport, and supply chain solutions, combining traditional family values with cutting-edge technology and a no-nonsense corporate culture.

At Katoen Natie, colleagues who take initiative and show dedication can grow quickly within their expanding international network.

Jobomschrijving

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 
• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scannersQuality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processingPacking & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labelingReceiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systemsInventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanlinessSafety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environmentTeam Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shiftsContinuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learnEnthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on youEye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operationsPhysical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shiftAvailability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)Basic Dutch or English communication skillsWhat Makes You Stand Out:Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipmentForklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)Previous experience in international logistics or port operationsMultilingual skills for our diverse, international workplacePositive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

Our client is a multinational.

Jobomschrijving

1. Waste data and performance improvement - approximately 60-80% of the time

• Take ownership of the waste topic and improve the reliability of existing data.
• Analyse and reconcile datasets, primarily using Excel, to identify inconsistencies,gaps and opportunities for improvement.
• Interview key stakeholders and data owners to understand data sources, processesand challenges.
• Recommend practical improvements to data collection, data quality and reporting.
• Identify initiatives that could reduce waste volumes and improve treatmentmethods.
• Prepare polished PowerPoint presentations, including clear charts and concise data analysis, for senior management and ExCo audiences. This consultant is not expected to provide technical expertise or lead a tool transformation. The focus is on strong analytical skills, the ability to interpret and challenge the data, and working with key stakeholders to develop action plans to reduce waste and improve treatment methods.
2. Other ESG projects - approximately 20-40% of the time

We are primarily looking for an experienced consultant with strong analytical skills and a quick learning curve; prior ESG experience is not essential.The ideal candidate:* Has a consulting background, ideally with a Big Four firm or equivalent, or haspreviously worked in a comparable consulting environment.* Has excellent analytical skills and is highly proficient in Excel.* Understands new topics quickly, adapts easily and becomes autonomous rapidly.* Delivers rigorous, reliable work right first time.* Can synthesise complex information and create compelling presentations for senioraudiences.* Is comfortable engaging with a range of stakeholders and coordinating projects.* Has a predominantly "Blue and Red" profile: analytical, structured, rigorous andresults-oriented.* Fluent in French and English; Dutch is an asset but not a requirement.

For a major Belgian organisation undergoing a large-scale digital transformation, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead strategic initiatives within the digital payments domain.

The mission focuses on the modernization of the payment ecosystem, including acquiring services, Payment Service Providers (Psp), payment compliance and the evolution of customer-facing digital Sales channels.
Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic payment-related projects.

• Analyse the current payment landscape, contracts and operating model.

• Gather and challenge business, technical, financial and regulatory requirements.

• Define the target strategy for acquiring and Psp services.

• Prepare business cases, decision documents and tender documentation.

• Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Security, Architecture, Procurement and Business stakeholders.

• Manage the impact analysis on existing Sales and payment systems.

• Drive the definition of future payment architectures and payment flows.

• Coordinate transition activities between current and future payment providers.

• Manage project planning, budget, risks, dependencies and governance.

• Oversee integration, testing, deployment and go-live activities.

• Lead steering committees and provide regular reporting to senior management.

• Drive PCI-DSS compliance initiatives and establish a sustainable certification approach.

Practical information

• Location: Brussels (hybrid)

• On-site presence: 2-3 days per week

• Start date: ASAP

• Contract: Freelance

• Duration: Initial mission of 3 months with strong extension potential

Interested in learning more? Send me your updated CV and I'll be happy to discuss this opportunity with you.

• Minimum 7 to 10 years of experience in complex project management environments.

• At least 3 years of experience in electronic payments, including Acquiring, Psp and payment ecosystems.

• Strong experience managing large-scale digital transformation projects.

• Proven experience coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders.

• Experience delivering projects in environments with strict regulatory and security requirements.

• Demonstrated experience with supplier and vendor management.

Key skills:

• Project Management

• Budget Management

• Risk & Dependency Management

• Stakeholder Management

• Business Analysis

• Payment Ecosystem (Acquiring, Psp, Card Payments)

• PCI-DSS Compliance

• Procurement & RFP Management

• Test & Transition Management

• Communication & Executive Reporting

Nice-to-have:

• Experience managing public tenders or large RFP processes.

• PMP and/or Prince2 Practitioner certification.

• Experience in highly regulated environments.

Languages:

• Native or bilingual level in French or Dutch

• Professional level in English

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.
 

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.
 

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.
 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
 
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
 
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
 
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
 
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
 
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
 
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
 
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
 
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations. 

 
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
 
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
 
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
 
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
 
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
 
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
 
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
 
• Good physical fitness.
 
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
 
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing organisation operating within a highly technical and project-driven production environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess the manufacturability and technical feasibility of customer-approved designs, identifying risks, constraints, and optimisation opportunities.

• Analytical, detail-oriented, and hands-on professional with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Analyze user requirements and collaborate with external partners to design effective technical solutions.

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
